verdict.rationale: Canny's own integrations link feedback to existing Jira, Linear and GitHub issues with status sync. Its changelog ties closed feedback to shipped releases, and the MCP page says a team roadmap exists and can be queried. None of this explicitly shows linking requests to roadmap features or initiatives inside Canny. Missing for 10: documented linking of requests to roadmap items, an initiatives concept, explicit release-to-request linkage docs, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can link feedback requests to roadmap features, initiatives, and releases

citations.quote: Announce what you shipped, show customers you heard them, and turn closed feedback into retention and upgrades.
Send feedback to Jira, link it to existing issues, and sync statuses.
